phenotype-registry

Phenotype Registry System: master index connecting specs, patterns, and templates.
Part of the Phenotype-org fleet canonical substrate registry (see KooshaPari/phenotype-registry).

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): entry point and project overview
- [SPEC.md](SPEC.md): one-page spec (Problem / Solution / Architecture / API / Status)
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): version history
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): security policy and reporting

## Optional

- [WORKLOG.md](WORKLOG.md): pheno-worklog-schema v2.1 (if present)
- [docs/adr/](docs/adr/): architecture decision records (if present)

## Notes

- Language/runtime: typescript
- Tier: 0
- Test coverage: 62%
- Registry entry: KooshaPari/phenotype-registry/registry/components.lock
- Maintained by: KooshaPari

## Absorbed from KooshaPari/PhenoHandbook (2026-09-10)

### PhenoHandbook

Living documentation for design patterns, anti-patterns, guidelines, methodologies,
and checklists across the Phenotype ecosystem. Doc-only MkDocs/VitePress site; no
runtime code. Referenced from ~80% of fleet ADRs.

#### Documentation

- [handbook/README.md](handbook/README.md): overview, quick start, registry structure, pattern format
- [handbook/AGENTS.md](handbook/AGENTS.md): project identity, conventions, what/when/when-not for AI agents
- [handbook/CHARTER.md](handbook/CHARTER.md): mission, tenets, in/out of scope, target users, success criteria
- [handbook/SPEC.md](handbook/SPEC.md): canonical specification (v1.0.0, 2026-04-04) -- content model, pattern format, governance
- [handbook/ADR.md](handbook/ADR.md): top-level ADR index + cross-pattern decision log
- [handbook/CHANGELOG.md](handbook/CHANGELOG.md): release notes (Keep a Changelog 1.1.0, SemVer 2.0.0)
- [handbook/PLAN.md](handbook/PLAN.md): roadmap / publishing pipeline
- [handbook/PRD.md](handbook/PRD.md): product requirements (long-form context for new contributors)
- [handbook/INDEX.md](handbook/INDEX.md): governance index (happy-path checklist + pre-commit guard)
- [handbook/VERSION](handbook/VERSION): current version (0.1.0)

#### Patterns

- [handbook/patterns/README.md](handbook/patterns/README.md): domain index (auth, caching, async, CI, observability, ...)
- [handbook/patterns/spine-roles.md](handbook/patterns/spine-roles.md): 4-role model for cross-repo spine work
- [handbook/patterns/feature-flagging.md](handbook/patterns/feature-flagging.md): feature flag patterns
- [handbook/patterns/architecture/](handbook/patterns/architecture/): hexagonal, microservices, event-driven architecture patterns
- [handbook/patterns/async/](handbook/patterns/async/): async, message-passing, queue patterns
- [handbook/patterns/ci/](handbook/patterns/ci/): CI/CD, quality-gate, SBOM, SLSA patterns
- [handbook/patterns/delegation/](handbook/patterns/delegation/): subagent dispatch, forge/codex patterns
- [handbook/patterns/governance/](handbook/patterns/governance/): governance meta-patterns (ADR, decision log, FR traceability)
- [handbook/patterns/methodology/](handbook/patterns/methodology/): TDD, BDD, DDD, xDD
- [handbook/patterns/stack/](handbook/patterns/stack/): language/stack-specific conventions
- [handbook/patterns/tooling/](handbook/patterns/tooling/): Justfile, Taskfile, pre-commit patterns
- [handbook/patterns/traceability/](handbook/patterns/traceability/): journey evidence, FR traceability

#### Anti-patterns

- [handbook/anti-patterns/README.md](handbook/anti-patterns/README.md): retired patterns registry
- [handbook/anti-patterns/language-bucket-sdk.md](handbook/anti-patterns/language-bucket-sdk.md): why `phenotype-{lang}-sdk` umbrella repos fail (ADR-017)
- [handbook/anti-patterns/mirror-to-empty-repo.md](handbook/anti-patterns/mirror-to-empty-repo.md): bulk-mirror anti-pattern

#### ADRs

- [handbook/adrs/](handbook/adrs/): MADR-format Architecture Decision Records (001-hexagonal, 002-NATS, 003-storage, 004-api, 005-auth, 006-deploy, 007-monitoring, 008-security, ...)
